units.source_text: 古歌：“憔悴深可耻，朝朝对镜颦。

en.t: An old poem says: How shameful it is to be so wasted and worn; every morning I face the mirror with a frown.

units.source_text: 纵然睡梦里，亦不愿逢君。”

en.t: Even in my dreams as I sleep, I do not wish to meet you.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 下文“出于何心”，暗示对他仍怀好感，故不欲使他看见丑颜。

en.t: The later phrase, from what feeling, hints that she still has affection for him, and therefore does not want him to see her ugly face.
